verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a notarization and incorporation API plus webhooks and system-triggered events. These are developer building blocks a user could wire into their own automations. They are not a product feature for setting up autonomous background automations such as scheduled jobs or trigger-action rules. The 'automate notarization workflows' line describes using the API, not a configurable automation capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
